page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, delivering a total of 128 vCPUs. This hardware configuration is paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the hardware profile entirely on high-density memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution.

From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring massive memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance. This profile is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, and heavy data processing workloads that demand substantial RAM capacity and high network throughput.
